items.title: Every derivation of the ring acts canonically on the local cohomology of an ideal as an additive operator satisfying the Leibniz rule
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file local-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement produces, for every derivation of the ring, a canonical additive operator on the local cohomology modules of a finitely generated ideal satisfying the Leibniz rule with respect to that derivation (author lemma at source lines 4180-4187, label lemma-derivation). The proof (source lines 4189-4201) is short but constructive: it represents the local cohomology by the Cech complex of the chosen generators, uses the unique extension of the derivation to each localisation appearing in the complex, and lets the extensions act degreewise. The point is that the action is canonical and compatible with the Leibniz rule, and both facts come from the explicit complex rather than from a functoriality statement. H2.
